answer: A newcomer locks a refundable 340 POA bond for 105 days behind one device key, and a hollow identity with no work history behind it cannot start paid jobs until the bond clears. Three auditors drawn by lot check the jetty ledger of finished jobs each month and replay one job live with 20 minutes notice. A clean record earns a relic credential paid work requires. A forged entry or a key shared across two identities burns the whole bond, revokes the credential, and bars the key for a year.
